notes.title: The Disappointing Present and Hopeful Future of NADYR
notes.notes:
Hi all,

To begin, THANK YOU SO MUCH! The reach of NADYR has been ridiculous, unexpected, and honestly, terrifying. I appreciate everyone who wishlisted the game, believed in the vision/idea of NADYR, and everyone who claimed/played the demo.

Now, speaking of the demo... It's no secret to me that the demo is/was a major disappointment. I got wrapped up in the excitement of putting [i]something[/i] out for NADYR that I lost sight of the timeline. Next Fest crept up on me faster than I anticipated, and I totally underestimated how much I still needed to do to make a good, playable demo.

So, I busted out many sleepless nights to try to reach the finish line on the demo, but I was ultimately unsuccessful. I should have realized that withdrawal from the Fest was the correct move, but I got a bit wrapped up in not wanting to see those long nights go to "waste". Besides, I bet only a dozen people would see NADYR's page at all, right? Well, as it would turn out, I misjudged that figure by nearly x1000.

So, where does that leave us today?

The truth is, I owe you all a proper demo. I want to make and play a proper NADYR demo [i]myself![/i] The NADYR demo will remain available, and it will be updated. It may take some time, but I've already continued working on improving the demo. Once the updated demo is out, I hope you will all try it!

After the demo is updated, I will do my best to continue to post announcements and updates on the games progress. I work a full-time job outside of the gaming industry, so I hope you'll exercise patience with me.

Once again, thank you all so much for the support, and please look forward to further updates!

Logan

notes.title: NADYR (Pre-Alpha) DEMO
notes.notes:
Happy Next Fest!

I've spent many gruelling nights working on getting a demo ready for NADYR. Unfortunately, even still, the demo is not of the highest quality. It is full of bugs, missing many art assets, and is overall, not the best indicator of the final game. Please temper expectations, should you try the demo for yourself.

Having said that, I would appreciate anyone who wishlists the game, seeing the heart and potential of NADYR through the grime. 

Either way, happy Next Fest, and thank you for your interest!

Logan
